args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.2.9, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.0 (the immediately preceding healthy release) is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and could not be used, so the rollback target was v2.2.9.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
2. Reviewed deployment history: v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release, but it is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417), so the rollback to v2.3.0 was rejected.
3. Rolled back to **v2.2.9**, the most recent healthy production release that is not quarantined. Rollback verified across all regions.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the failure and the rollback (including the note that v2.3.0 was skipped due to the CVE quarantine).

Rollback to v2.2.9 succeeded. Now open SEV2 incident.
